title: Composite data over electrical cables
summary: Electrical cable anchors document separate data send and receive interfaces.
body: The electrical cable anchor tooltip permits one rope logic link between two anchors, carrying data and electricity. Its ports describe composite, on/off, video and audio send and receive paths. These are port types, not channel counts. A native check (investigation/config.md) of the scalar input getter 0x1408cacf0 found that it copies a cached value and returns, so reading an input does not evaluate the upstream graph. It does not show when that cache is refreshed.

findings.label: Scalar input getter
findings.value: returns the cached value at input + 0x18
findings.detail: Load, copy to the result, return. No recursive evaluation of upstream components. Bytes 8b 41 18 89 02 c3 at 0x1408cacf0. Report: investigation/config.md.

limitations: Block definitions document configuration and interfaces. Generic serialized fields can exist on unrelated block types; only relevant fields are selected here.
These are supplied resources. No game process was executed, and native code loading, overrides and effective runtime values remain unverified.

Still not decoded: the type-48 anchor's composite payload storage and copy routine, numeric and on/off channel layout and numbering, video and audio ownership, endpoint update order, transfer from producer to cache, cross-vehicle latency, microcontroller limits and Lua scheduling. The XML port types, the one-link tooltip, the empty microprocessor tooltips and the cached getter give no basis for those claims, and no composite packet format or fixed one-update latency was recovered.
